messages:
maya: quick one — tiny naming/formatting nit in https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4527. requestID in the proto and some Go structs is mixed case. Would rather `request_id` everywhere. Who can pick this and land before today's merge window?

alex: I can take it. quick question: do we want a compatibility shim for JSON tags (keep `requestID` json tag) or change both field name and json tag to `request_id`?

joe: +1 to JSON compat for now, simpler. we can change json tags later in a follow-up. also CI is flaky on the windows builder right now — may need a rerun.

alex: ok I'll open a tiny patch. plan: run `gofmt`/`gofumpt` and update proto -> regenerate. patch will be under 10 lines. example:
```
- RequestID string `json:"requestID"`
+ RequestID string `json:"request_id"`
```
I'll make the proto change and run `make protos` locally.

sam: pinging owners: @eng-runtime and @eng-platform — we need one approval from runtime owners before merge. Sam: can we get an approval relay?

linda: I can review once alex pushes. small FYI: update to the proto will bump the generated files; please keep generated diffs minimal (no whitespace churn).

ci-bot: retriggered CI for #4527 — build started :gear:

maya: thanks everyone. alex, if you can land by 17:00 PT I'll hold a merge slot and do the final ok. otherwise we'll defer to next slot. :thumbsup:

alex: on it, should be done within the hour. will @maya when ready.
